method: Public source and documentation inspection only; no third-party code executed and no tests independently rerun.

repositories.scope: Backend, simulator, causal feature and thermal modules; implementation phase plans
Overlapping project family, backend and locally simulated frontend

participation: Same collaborating project family inferred from repository references and team component. Public PowerNext/CPRI mentions support relevance, but no official finalist registration or track mapping verified.

strengths.finding: Nullable per-phase voltage/current, neutral current, thermal/protection/power fields; CSV adapter isolates raw names, keeps outer-aligned missing observations, explicit duplicate policies by field semantics.

Per-asset/per-type active episodes, timestamp ordering, severity escalation, acknowledgement and configurable consecutive-clear resolution; invalid inference does not automatically clear analytical alerts.
PLAN/URGENT records linked to analytics, deduplicated by open priority and reason set; completion state persisted.
Time-window queries, pagination, bucket aggregation, 10k-row ingestion profiling and million-row read profiling.
722 backend tests reported, no skips; actual PostgreSQL and Mosquitto claimed; fresh-stack/non-root runtime/reset/reseed verification described.
Direct load/ambient controls and neighboring waveform, thermal residual, component health and recommended-action panels make cause/effect easy to narrate.

strengths.status: source implemented, not backend-integrated by default
strengths.finding: Per-asset causal recurrence, actual elapsed-time response, required explicit coefficients, missing residual for missing observations, duplicate identity validation.

limitations.finding: Default ML backend is stub. Scores primarily respond to protection flags; thermal outputs remain null. Thermal module presence does not prove deployed integration.
Frontend imports local scenario engine. Confidence 0.92, latency 11.4 ms and zero-leakage statement are literals; scenario labels directly drive diagnosis; historical curves are generated.
General APIs lack auth; MQTT queue and replay jobs are not durable; units unverified; latest source/timestamp duplicates need payload-conflict policy rather than blind dedupe.

Future remediation plan acknowledges unsafe historical output writes from tests, binary WTI misinterpretation, incomplete-phase calculations and unknown source time/unit semantics; plans are not proof of completed remediation.
Anomaly, health, forecasting, calibrated evaluation and unified model integration are specified as implementation phases, not established analytical results in inspected ML source.

already_present_do_not_rebuild: Idempotent device frame handling and lost-ack recovery
Evidence-linked maintenance and closure checks in existing modes
CSV import and frozen prediction scoring
targeted_gaps: Immutable config/calibration/firmware/schema binding per frame and assessment
Measured query/ingestion performance and bounded history interfaces
Explicit episode lifecycle across imported observations
Broader phase-aware import semantics without fabricating unmeasured channels
Visual cause/effect and synchronized evidence inspection
halo_comparison.ui_status: Health dial/contribution/3D links, mode-honest waveforms, unified thermal-state display, inline intervention preview/apply and synchronized alert replay are IN PROGRESS under a later user request. Completion requires integration tests and browser verification.
